newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: ICN, OHIS Macedonia to set up joint venture.
newsitem.headline: ICN, OHIS Macedonia to set up joint venture.

text.p: ICN Pharmaceuticals Inc and Macedonian pharmaceuticals company OHIS of Skopje have signed a preliminary agreement to found a joint stock company, ICN said in a statement released on Tuesday.
Under the preliminary agreement ICN Pharmaceuticals will have a 75 percent share in the new company, which is to begin operating in six months.
The company, ICN Macedonia, will produce and distribute ICN medicines in Macedonia.
The value of the investments is $20 million, ICN said. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 2224305
